turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a and an?
turns.tutor:
Here is one example, step by step: ___ egg. I look at the first sound of egg. It is "e". So I write an: an egg.
The rule: use an before an a, e, i, o or u sound; use a before other sounds.
Right: Sam eats an egg. Wrong: Sam eats a egg.
Your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
